wins: Completed initial infrastructure reconnaissance within first 5 minutes, identifying 4 live hosts (ep001_step06)
Documented exposed web service on port 8080 with preliminary content analysis (ep001_step09)
fails: Could not capture any objective markers; exploitation attempts for user and root flags were unsuccessful (ep001_step22)
Repeated meterpreter deployment failed due to missing writable directories and defensive monitoring alerts (ep001_step18)
key_outcomes.summary: Run favored rapid reconnaissance but stalled during exploitation, producing high telemetry (reward 60) without achieving success criteria.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts aborted when the target SSH service presented a strict banner and immediate IDS detection, forcing session tear-down.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts followed by ssh-audit

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web service responds with directory listings or server headers
skill_cards.then_action: Launch gobuster with wordlist + take baseline Burp request to identify reusable paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When foothold is gained with limited shell
skill_cards.then_action: Run linpeas and collect sudo -l output before privilege escalation

memory_ops.reason: Consistently collected SSH service data quickly, enabling follow-on enumeration despite failed exploit attempts
Web content discovery mapped directories that will inform future exploitation planning

next_experiments.title: Strengthen SSH persistence attempts
next_experiments.description: After successful SSH enumeration, test credential stuffing or key-based auth to bypass banner restrictions and avoid IDS triggers.

next_experiments.title: Automate internal web path discovery
next_experiments.description: Feed gobuster findings into Burp Intruder to validate overlooked endpoints for file upload or config disclosure.

next_experiments.title: Improve post-exploitation context
next_experiments.description: If shell is obtained, immediately run linpeas and sudo -l to catalog privilege escalation vectors before IDS resets the session.
